run_instruction_for_duration: run a natural language instruction on the robot for a specified duration then return task success
create_RunInstructionForDurationTool: create a RunInstructionForDurationTool with an event bus, embodiment run instruction tool, and optional stop tool
configure_stop_on_success: configure the RunInstructionForDurationTool to automatically stop the robot after successful instruction completion
use_lockstep_timer: use a custom lockstep timer callable instead of wall-clock sleep for simulation backend timing
handle_tool_call_cancellation: handle tool call cancellation events by setting the cancelled flag when the call ID matches
